module mod_t_list
  implicit none
  type :: t_list
    integer :: vol
    integer, pointer :: arr(:)
  end type t_list
  private
  public :: t_list, init_list, push_back, pop_back
  public :: poll_back, get_at, size_of_list
contains
  subroutine init_list(list)
    implicit none
    type(t_list), intent(inout) :: list
    list%vol = 0
    nullify(list%arr)
    allocate(list%arr(1))
    return
  end subroutine init_list
  subroutine push_back(list,n)
    implicit none
    type(t_list), intent(inout) :: list
    integer, intent(in) :: n
    integer, allocatable :: tmp(:)
    if (size(list%arr).eq.list%vol) then
      allocate(tmp(list%vol))
      tmp = list%arr
      deallocate(list%arr)
      allocate(list%arr(2*list%vol))
      list%arr(1:list%vol) = tmp
      deallocate(tmp)
    end if
    list%vol = list%vol+1
    list%arr(list%vol) = n
    return
  end subroutine push_back
  function pop_back(list) result(n)
    implicit none
    type(t_list), intent(inout) :: list
    integer :: n
    n = list%arr(list%vol)
    list%vol = list%vol-1
    return
  end function pop_back
  subroutine poll_back(list)
    implicit none
    type(t_list), intent(inout) :: list
    list%vol = list%vol-1
    return
  end subroutine poll_back
  function get_at(list,i) result(n)
    implicit none
    type(t_list), intent(in) :: list
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer :: n
    n = list%arr(i)
    return
  end function get_at
  function size_of_list(list) result(s)
    implicit none
    type(t_list), intent(in) :: list
    integer :: s
    s = list%vol
    return
  end function size_of_list
end module mod_t_list
module mod_t_graph
  use mod_t_list
  implicit none
  integer, allocatable :: color(:)
  type :: t_graph
    type(t_list), pointer :: edges(:)
  end type t_graph
  private
  public :: t_graph, init_graph, add, is_bipartite
contains
  subroutine init_graph(graph,n)
    implicit none
    type(t_graph), intent(inout) :: graph
    integer, intent(in) :: n
    integer :: i
    allocate(color(n))
    color = 0
    allocate(graph%edges(n))
    do i = 1, n
      call init_list(graph%edges(i))
    end do
    return
  end subroutine init_graph
  subroutine add(graph,i,pos)
    implicit none
    type(t_graph), intent(inout) :: graph
    integer, intent(in) :: i, pos
    call push_back(graph%edges(i),pos)
    return
  end subroutine add
  recursive function is_bipartite(graph,v) result(w)
    implicit none
    type(t_graph), intent(inout) :: graph
    integer :: v, i, e, w, s, t
    if (v.lt.0) then
      color(1) = 1
      w = is_bipartite(graph,1)
      return
    end if
    w = -1
    s = 0
    do i = 1, size_of_list(graph%edges(v))
      e = get_at(graph%edges(v),i)
      if (color(e).eq.color(v)) return
      if (color(e).eq.0) then
        color(e) = -color(v)
        t = is_bipartite(graph,e)
        if (t.lt.0) return
        s = s+t
        if (color(v).eq.1) s = s+1
      end if
    end do
    w = s
    return
  end function is_bipartite
end module mod_t_graph
program three_step
  use mod_t_graph
  implicit none
  type(t_graph) :: graph
  integer :: n, m, a, b, w, i
  read(*,*) n, m
  call init_graph(graph,n)
  do i = 1, m
    read(*,*) a, b
    call add(graph,a,b)
    call add(graph,b,a)
  end do
  w = is_bipartite(graph,-1)
  if (w.lt.0) then

  else
    write(*,'(i0)') int(w,8)*int(n-w,8)-int(m,8)
  end if
  stop
end program three_step

local edge, len = {}, {}
local taskstate = {}
for i = 1, n do
  edge[i] = {}
  len[i] = 0
  taskstate[i] = false
end
len[1] = 1
taskstate[1] = true

for i = 1, m do
  local a, b = io.read("*n", "*n")
  edge[a][b], edge[b][a] = true, true
end

local tasks = {1}
while 0 < #tasks do
  local src = tasks[#tasks]
  taskstate[src] = false
  table.remove(tasks)
  local f1 = len[src] % 2 == 1
  local f2 = 1 < len[src]

    local up = false
    if f1 and len[dst] <= 1 then

      up = true
    end

      up = true
    end

      table.insert(tasks, dst)
    end
  end

{-# OPTIONS_GHC -O2 #-}
import qualified Data.Vector.Unboxed as VU
import qualified Data.Vector.Unboxed.Mutable as VUM
import qualified Data.Vector as V
import qualified Data.Vector.Mutable as VM
import Data.Array.Unboxed
import Data.Array.ST
import Data.STRef 
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import Control.Monad
import Control.Monad.ST
import Data.List
import Data.Char
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as M

convert :: Int -> Int -> VU.Vector (Int,Int) -> V.Vector [Int]
convert n e graph = V.create $ do
    v <- VM.replicate n []
    forM_ [0..e-1] $ \i -> do
        let (x,y) = graph VU.! i
        VM.modify v (y-1:) (x-1)
        VM.modify v (x-1:) (y-1)
    return v

bipartite :: Int -> V.Vector [Int] -> Maybe (VU.Vector Int)
bipartite n graph = runST $ do
    vec <- VUM.replicate n (-1)
    VUM.write vec 0 0
    go [0] vec
    where go :: [Int] -> VUM.MVector s Int -> ST s (Maybe (VU.Vector Int))
          go [] vec = do
              vv <- VU.freeze vec
              return $ Just vv
          go (n:ns) vec = do
              now <- VUM.read vec n
              ls <- newSTRef ns
              flag <- newSTRef False
              forM_ (graph V.! n) $ \i -> do
                  b <- VUM.read vec i
                  when (b == -1) $ VUM.write vec i (1-now) >> modifySTRef ls (i:)
                  when (b == now) $ writeSTRef flag True
              ln <- readSTRef ls
              ff <- readSTRef flag
              if ff then return Nothing else go ln vec


main :: IO ()
main = do
    [n,m] <- unfoldr (BS.readInt . BS.dropWhile isSpace) <$> BS.getLine
    graph <- convert n m <$> (VU.replicateM m $ (\vec -> (vec VU.! 0, vec VU.! 1)) . VU.unfoldrN 2 (BS.readInt . BS.dropWhile isSpace) <$> BS.getLine)
    print $ case bipartite n graph of
        Nothing -> (n*(n-1))`div`2-m
        Just vec -> let len = VU.sum vec in len*(n-len) - m

main = do
  [n, m] <- map read . words <$> getLine
  g <- newArray (0, n - 1) [] :: IO (IOArray Int [Int])
  forM_ [1..m] $ \_ -> do
    [u, v] <- map pred . map read . words <$> getLine
    readArray g u >>= writeArray g u . (v:)
    readArray g v >>= writeArray g v . (u:)
  g' <- V.fromList <$> getElems g
  let (c, f) = testBipartite g'
  let white = length . filter (==True) . map snd . M.toList $ c
  let black = length . filter (==False) . map snd . M.toList $ c
  print $ if f then white*black - m
               else n*(n-1)`div`2 - m

testBipartite :: V.Vector [Int] -> (M.Map Int Bool, Bool)
testBipartite = dfs 0 False M.empty

dfs :: Int -> Bool -> M.Map Int Bool -> V.Vector [Int] -> (M.Map Int Bool, Bool)
dfs u c m g = foldl' f (M.insert u c m, True) $ g V.! u
  where
    f :: (M.Map Int Bool, Bool) -> Int -> (M.Map Int Bool, Bool)
    f (m, False) _ = (m, False)
    f (m, True) v = case M.lookup v m
                    of Just c' -> (m, c /= c')
                       Nothing -> dfs v (not c) m g

parseInt(x) = parse(Int, x)
parseMap(x::Array{SubString{String},1}) = map(parseInt, x)
function root(uf::Array{Int,1},x);s=x;while uf[s]>0;s=uf[s];end;s;end
same(uf::Array{Int,1},x,y)=root(uf,x)==root(uf,y)?true:false;
function unite(uf::Array{Int,1},x,y);l=root(uf,x);r=root(uf,y);if l!=r;if uf[l]<uf[r];uf[l]+=uf[r];uf[r]=l;else;uf[r]+=uf[l];uf[l]=r;end;end;end

function main()
	n,m = readline() |> split |> parseMap
	d = zeros(Int,n)
	e = Tuple{Int,Int}[(0,0) for i in 1:m]
	for i in 1:m
		a,b = readline() |> split |> parseMap
		d[a] += 1
		d[b] += 1
		e[i] = (a,b)
	end
	fo = 0
	fn = 0
	for i in 1:n
		if d[i]==1
			fo += 1
		elseif d[i]==n-1
			fn += 1
		end
	end
	if fo==n-1&&fn==1&&m+1==n
		println(0)
	else
		uf = -ones(Int,2*n)
		for i in 1:m
			unite(uf,e[i][1],e[i][2]+n)
			unite(uf,e[i][1]+n,e[i][2])
		end
		f = 0
		for i in 1:n
			if same(uf,i,n+i)
				f = 1
				break
			end
		end
		if f==1
			println(div(n*(n-1),2)-m)
		else
			g = [Int[] for i in 1:n]
			for i in 1:m
				push!(g[e[i][1]],e[i][2])
				push!(g[e[i][2]],e[i][1])
			end
			ab = zeros(Int,n)
			ab[1] = 1
			stack = Int[1]
			while !isempty(stack)
				now = pop!(stack)
				for i in g[now]
					if ab[i]==0
						push!(stack,i)
						ab[i]=ab[now]*(-1)
					end
				end
			end
			f = 0
			for i in 1:n
				if ab[i]==1
					f += 1
				end
			end
			println(f*(n-f)-m)
		end
	end
end

main()

(defun bipartite-p (graph)
  "Decides if GRAPH is bipartite. GRAPH is a vector of adjacency list."
  (declare ((simple-array list (*)) graph))
  (let* ((n (length graph))
         ;; 1: black, -1: white, 0: undecided
         (colors (make-array n :element-type '(signed-byte 2) :initial-element 0)))
    (labels ((dfs (vertex color)
               (cond ((zerop (aref colors vertex))
                      (setf (aref colors vertex) color)
                      (if (= color 1)
                          (dolist (neighbor (aref graph vertex))
                            (dfs neighbor -1))
                          (dolist (neighbor (aref graph vertex))
                            (dfs neighbor 1))))
                     ((/= color (aref colors vertex))
                      (return-from bipartite-p nil)))))
      (dotimes (i n colors)
        (when (zerop (aref colors i))
          (dfs i 1))))))

(defmacro buffered-read-line (&optional (buffer-size 30) (in '*standard-input*) (terminate-char #\Space))
  "Note that the returned string will be reused."
  (let ((buffer (gensym))
        (character (gensym))
        (idx (gensym)))
    `(let ((,buffer (load-time-value (make-string ,buffer-size
                                                  :element-type 'base-char))))
       (declare (simple-base-string ,buffer))
       (loop for ,character of-type base-char =
                #-swank (code-char (read-byte ,in nil #.(char-code #\Newline)))
                #+swank (read-char ,in nil #\Newline)
             for ,idx from 0
             until (char= ,character #\Newline)
             do (setf (schar ,buffer ,idx) ,character)
             finally (when (< ,idx ,buffer-size)
                       (setf (schar ,buffer ,idx) ,terminate-char))
                     (return (values ,buffer ,idx))))))

(defmacro split-ints-bind (vars string &body body)
  (let ((position (gensym))
        (s (gensym)))
    (labels ((expand (vars &optional init-pos)
               (if (null vars)
                   body
                   `((multiple-value-bind (,(car vars) ,position)
                         (parse-integer ,s :start ,(or init-pos position)
                                           :junk-allowed t)
                       ,@(when (null (cdr vars)) `((declare (ignore ,position))))
                       ,@(expand (cdr vars)))))))
      `(let ((,s ,string))
         (declare (string ,s))
         ,@(expand vars 0)))))

def is_bipartite_graph(graph)
  stack = [[graph.keys.first, 1]]

  red = []
  white = []

  until stack.empty?
    puts graph.inspect
    point, color = stack.pop
    if color == 1
      return false if white.include?(point)
      red << point unless red.include?(point)
    else
      return false if red.include?(point)
      white << point unless white.include?(point)
    end
    next if graph[point].nil?
    graph[point].each do |p|
      stack << [p, (color - 1).abs]
    end
    graph.delete(point)
  end
  [red.size, white.size]
end

def dfs(e)
	stack = [] # stack
	f = Array.new(e.size){false} # is searched flag
	d = Array.new(e.size)
	# init
	s=0
	f[s]=true
	d[s]=0
	e[s].each{|v|
		stack.push([v,s,1]) #v,d to v
	} 
	while(!stack.empty?)
		curv,curp,curd = stack.pop
		f[curv]=true
		d[curv]=curd
		e[curv].each{|nxtv|
			nxtd = curd+1
			if !f[nxtv]
				stack.push([nxtv,curv,nxtd])
			else
				# false if not even cycle
				return [false,[]] if (nxtd-d[nxtv]) %2 != 0
			end
		}
	end
	return [true,d]
end

def is_bipartite_graph(graph)
  stack = [[graph.keys.first, 1]]

  red = []
  white = []

  until stack.empty?
    point, color = stack.pop
    if color == 1
      return false if white.include?(point)
      red << point unless red.include?(point)
    else
      return false if red.include?(point)
      white << point unless white.include?(point)
    end
    next if graph[point].nil?
    graph[point].each do |p|
      stack << [p, (color - 1).abs]
    end
    graph.delete(point)
  end
  [red.size, white.size]
end

def dfs(e)
	stack = []
	f = Array.new(e.size){false}
	d = Array.new(e.size)
	s=0
	f[s]=true
	d[s]=0
	devencnt = 1
	e[s].each{|v| stack.push([v,s,1])} 
	while(!stack.empty?)
		curv,curp,curd = stack.pop
		f[curv]=true
		d[curv]=curd
		devencnt += 1 if curd%2==0
		e[curv].each{|nxtv|
			nxtd = curd+1
			if !f[nxtv]
				stack.push([nxtv,curv,nxtd])
			else
				# false if not even cycle
				return [false,0] if (nxtd-d[nxtv]) %2 != 0
			end
		}
	end
	return [true,devencnt]
end

  stack = [[graph.keys.first, 1]]

  white = []

    point, color = stack.pop
    if color == 1
      return false if white.include?(point)
      red << point

    graph.delete(point)

  [red.uniq.size, white.uniq.size]

from collections import deque


def is_bipartite_graph(graph):
    """二部グラフかどうか判定し、黒色白色で塗り分けるときのそれぞれの頂点の個数を返す
    二部グラフでないときは(-1, -1)を返す
    """
    n = len(graph)
    visited = [-1] * n
    visited[0] = 0
    q = deque([0])
    while q:
        pos = q.pop()
        for next_pos in graph[pos]:
            if visited[next_pos] >= 0:
                if visited[next_pos] != visited[pos]:
                    continue
                else:
                    return -1, -1
            visited[next_pos] = visited[pos] ^ 1
            q.append(next_pos)
    cnt_0 = 0
    cnt_1 = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if visited[i]:
            cnt_1 += 1
        else:
            cnt_0 += 1
            
    return cnt_0, cnt_1

def is_biparate(links):
    '''
    0=white,1=blackとする
    2部グラフなら黒に塗られている頂点の数を返す
    2部グラフでないなら-1を返す。
    '''
    
    colors = [-1] * n
    colors[0] = 0
    q = [(0, 0)]  #0=white, 1=blackとする
    visited = set()
    while q:
        v, c = q.pop()
        if v in visited:
            if colors[v] != c: #最初に塗られた色とは反対の色が塗られるなら
                return -1
            continue
        visited.add(v)
        colors[v] = c
        for u in links[v]:
            q.append((u, c ^ 1))  #0^0=1 1^1=0 vとは反対の色を塗る
    return sum(colors)  #1の数 = blackの数

class Tree:
    WHITE = 0
    GRAY = -1
    BLACK = 1

    def __init__(self, adj):
        n = len(adj)
        self.adj = adj
        self.colors = [self.WHITE] * n
        self.depths = [-1] * n
        self.depth = 0

    def init(self):
        self.__init__(self.adj)

    def dfs(self, u):
        if self.colors[u] == self.BLACK:
            return

        self.colors[u] = self.GRAY
        self.depths[u] = self.depth

        for v, w in self.adj[u]:
            if self.colors[v] == self.WHITE:
                self.depth += w
                self.dfs(v)
                self.depth -= w

        self.colors[u] = self.BLACK

    def bipartite_graph(self, u, c):
        self.colors[u] = c
        for v in self.adj[u]:
            if self.colors[v] == c:
                return False
            if self.colors[v] == self.WHITE and not self.bipartite_graph(v, -c):
                return False

        return True

    colors = [-1] * n
    colors[0] = 0
    q = [(0, 0)]
    visited = set()
    cnt = 0
    while q:
        v, c = q.pop()
        if v in visited:
            if colors[v] != c:
                return False
            continue
        visited.add(v)
        colors[v] = c
        cnt += c
        for u in links[v]:
            q.append((u, c ^ 1))
    return cnt

        self.adj = adj
        self.colors = [self.WHITE] * n
        self.depths = [-1] * n
        self.depth = 0

    def init(self):
        self.__init__(self.adj)

    def dfs(self, u):
        if self.colors[u] == self.BLACK:

        self.colors[u] = self.GRAY
        self.depths[u] = self.depth

        for v in self.adj[u]:
            if self.colors[v] == self.WHITE:
                self.depth += 1
                self.dfs(v)
                self.depth -= 1
            elif (self.depths[u] - self.depths[v]) % 2 == 0:
                return False

        self.colors[u] = self.BLACK

        return True

class UnionFindVerSize():
    def __init__(self, N):
        """ N個のノードのUnion-Find木を作成する """
        # 親の番号を格納する。自分が親だった場合は、自分の番号になり、それがそのグループの番号になる
        self._parent = [n for n in range(0, N)]
        # グループのサイズ（個数）
        self._size = [1] * N
        self._even = [i%2 for i in range(0,N)]
        self._odd =[(i+1)%2 for i in range(0,N)]

    def find_root(self, x):
        """ xの木の根(xがどのグループか)を求める """
        if self._parent[x] == x: return x
        self._parent[x] = self.find_root(self._parent[x]) # 縮約
        return self._parent[x]

    def unite(self, x, y):
        """ xとyの属するグループを併合する """
        gx = self.find_root(x)
        gy = self.find_root(y)
        if gx == gy: return

        # 小さい方を大きい方に併合させる（木の偏りが減るので）
        if self._size[gx] < self._size[gy]:
            self._parent[gx] = gy
            self._size[gy] += self._size[gx]
            self._even[gy] += self._even[gx]
            self._odd[gy] += self._odd[gx]
        else:
            self._parent[gy] = gx
            self._size[gx] += self._size[gy]
            self._even[gx] += self._even[gy]
            self._odd[gx] += self._odd[gy]

    def get_size(self, x):
        """ xが属するグループのサイズ（個数）を返す """
        return self._size[self.find_root(x)]

    def is_same_group(self, x, y):
        """ xとyが同じ集合に属するか否か """
        return self.find_root(x) == self.find_root(y)

    def calc_group_num(self):
        """ グループ数を計算して返す """
        N = len(self._parent)
        ans = 0
        for i in range(N):
            if self.find_root(i) == i:
                ans += 1
        return ans

    def calc_comb(self):
        N=len(self._parent)
        ans=0
        for i in range(N):
            if self.find_root(i) ==i:
                ans+=self._even[i]*self._odd[i]
        return ans

from sys import stdin, stdout
def readLine_int_list():return list(map(int, stdin.readline().split()))

def is_biparate(links):
    '''
    0=white,1=blackとする
    2部グラフなら黒に塗られている頂点の数を返す
    2部グラフでないなら-1を返す。
    '''
    
    colors = [-1] * n
    colors[0] = 0
    q = [(0, 0)]  #0=white, 1=blackとする
    visited = set()
    while q:
        v, c = q.pop()
        if v in visited:
            if colors[v] != c: #最初に塗られた色とは反対の色が塗られるなら
                return -1
            continue
        visited.add(v)
        colors[v] = c
        for u in links[v]:
            q.append((u, c ^ 1))  #0^1=1 1^1=0 vとは反対の色を塗る
    return sum(colors)  #1の数 = blackの数

        a, b = readLine_int_list()
        a -= 1

        g[a].add(b)
        g[b].add(a)
    
    
    
    bp1 = is_biparate(g)
    if bp1 == -1:
        '''
        2部グラフではない場合
            結論：完全グラフになるまで辺を追加できる
            →why
                奇サイクル上のある点をvとする
                s → v → tが偶数長でも、 奇サイクルの他の頂点を余計に経由することで奇数長になる
                s → tが奇数長になれば線が引ける
                つまり、任意の頂点間において奇数長が存在することになる
            完全グラフの辺の数は、n * (n - 1) // 2
            これには元あった辺の数まで含まれているので、 -m する
        '''
        max_m = n * (n - 1) // 2
    else:
        '''
        2部グラフの場合
            結論:(blackの数*whiteの数)本、線ができる
            why
                奇数閉路が存在しない => 異なる色間は必ず奇数長、同色間は必ず偶数長 
                1. whiteとblackの間は奇数長のパスが存在する ->線が引ける

                black=3, white=2の時の線の引き方 = b*w
            b*wにはパスの長さが1つまりもともとのパスが含まれてるので、-m　する
        '''
        max_m = bp1 * (n - bp1)

class UnionFindVerSize():
    def __init__(self, N):
        """ N個のノードのUnion-Find木を作成する """
        # 親の番号を格納する。自分が親だった場合は、自分の番号になり、それがそのグループの番号になる
        self._parent = [n for n in range(0, N)]
        # グループのサイズ（個数）
        self._size = [1] * N
        self._even = [i%2 for i in range(0,N)]
        self._odd =[(i+1)%2 for i in range(0,N)]

    def find_root(self, x):
        """ xの木の根(xがどのグループか)を求める """
        if self._parent[x] == x: return x
        self._parent[x] = self.find_root(self._parent[x]) # 縮約
        return self._parent[x]

    def unite(self, x, y):
        """ xとyの属するグループを併合する """
        gx = self.find_root(x)
        gy = self.find_root(y)
        if gx == gy: return

        # 小さい方を大きい方に併合させる（木の偏りが減るので）
        if self._size[gx] < self._size[gy]:
            self._parent[gx] = gy
            self._size[gy] += self._size[gx]
            self._even[gy] += self._even[gx]
            self._odd[gy] += self._odd[gx]
        else:
            self._parent[gy] = gx
            self._size[gx] += self._size[gy]
            self._even[gx] += self._even[gy]
            self._odd[gx] += self._odd[gy]

    def get_size(self, x):
        """ xが属するグループのサイズ（個数）を返す """
        return self._size[self.find_root(x)]

    def is_same_group(self, x, y):
        """ xとyが同じ集合に属するか否か """
        return self.find_root(x) == self.find_root(y)

    def calc_group_num(self):
        """ グループ数を計算して返す """
        N = len(self._parent)
        ans = 0
        for i in range(N):
            if self.find_root(i) == i:
                ans += 1
        return ans

    def calc_comb(self):
        N=len(self._parent)
        ans=0
        for i in range(N):
            if self.find_root(i) ==i:
                ans+=self._even[i]*self._odd[i]
        return ans

class Tree:
    WHITE = 0
    GRAY = 1
    BLACK = 2

    def __init__(self, adj):
        n = len(adj)
        self.adj = adj
        self.colors = [self.WHITE] * n
        self.depths = [-1] * n
        self.depth = 0

    def init(self):
        self.__init__(self.adj)

    def dfs(self, u):
        if self.colors[u] == self.BLACK:
            return

        self.colors[u] = self.GRAY
        self.depths[u] = self.depth

        for v in self.adj[u]:
            if self.colors[v] == self.WHITE:
                self.depth += 1
                self.dfs(v)
                self.depth -= 1
            elif (self.depths[u] - self.depths[v]) % 2 == 0:
                return False

        self.colors[u] = self.BLACK

        return True
